00108 int AndroidIOHost::processBlock(const int bufferLength, short *shortBuffer) throw()
00109 {
00110   float *floatBufferData[2];
00111   floatBufferData[0] = floatBuffer;
00112   floatBufferData[1] = floatBuffer + blockSize;
00113   
00114   static const float upScale = 32767.f;
00115   static const float downScale = 1.f / upScale;
00116   
00117   for(int channel = 0; channel < numInputs; channel++)
00118   {
00119     short *shortBufferChannel = shortBuffer + channel;
00120     float *floatBufferChannel = floatBufferData[channel];
00121     
00122     int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00123     
00124     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00125     {
00126       *floatBufferChannel = (float)(*shortBufferChannel) * downScale;
00127       
00128       floatBufferChannel++;
00129       shortBufferChannel += numInputs;
00130     }
00131   }
00132   
00133   lock(); 
00134   {
00135     // set inputs...
00136     input.setInputs((const float**)floatBufferData, blockSize, numInputs);
00137     
00138     // set outputs
00139     output.setOutputs(floatBufferData, blockSize, numOutputs);
00140     
00141     currentBlockID = UGen::getNextBlockID(blockSize);
00142     output.prepareAndProcessBlock(blockSize, currentBlockID, -1);
00143   }
00144   unlock(); 
00145 
00146   for(int channel = 0; channel < numOutputs; channel++)
00147   {
00148     short *shortBufferChannel = shortBuffer + channel;
00149     float *floatBufferChannel = floatBufferData[channel];
00150     
00151     int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00152     
00153     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00154     {
00155       *shortBufferChannel = (short)(*floatBufferChannel * upScale);
00156             
00157       floatBufferChannel++;
00158       shortBufferChannel += numInputs;
00159     }
00160   }
00161   
00162   return 0;
00163 }
